wikimediaantiabuse-api-falsepositive-per: Error message shown over the REST API when the user lacks permission to change the false positive status of a revision.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-falsepositive-not: Error message shown over the REST API when trying to mark a revision that is not marked with an abuse review tag.
Error message shown over the REST API when trying to unmark a revision that is not currently marked as a false positive.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-falsepositive-dis: Error message shown over the REST API when the false positive feature is disabled by configuration.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-falsepositive-unk:
Error message shown over the REST API when the requested tag is not one that supports false-positive review.

Parameters:
* $1 - the requested tag name.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-falsepositive-blo: Error message shown over the REST API when a user who is blocked tries to change the false positive status of a revision.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-falsepositive-mar: Description of what the mark-as-false-positive REST endpoint does, shown to API consumers in the generated API documentation.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-falsepositive-unm: Description of what the unmark-as-false-positive REST endpoint does, shown to API consumers in the generated API documentation.
